information: ## Due to the incoming Hurricane Milton, we have made the decision to **CANCEL** St. Augustine Fall 2024. Despite the hurricane expecting to pass by Saturday, we want to ensure our competitor’s safety by cancelling the competition. ### All competitors will receive a full refund of their registration fee.
